/* D003 test-only dual-target injector, version R3 (P05-S4 R8 M2a2, U244 rule set R3).
 *
 * Test-only.  Linked only by the R8 M2a2 apparatus builds (never into S4/).  Built as a
 * separate translation unit from the R2 injector: inject_r8m2a2_dual_R2.cpp is kept
 * unchanged for provenance.  Changes relative to R2 are listed in
 * checkpoints/p05/evidence/p05-s4r8/m2a2/SRC_DIFF_R8_M2a2_inject_dual_R3.txt
 * (generated by diff_src_r8m2a2) and explained in the round report.
 *
 * Target 1 (S4FMM_INJECT / S4FMM_NTH) keeps the R2 behaviour.  Target 2 is S4FMM_INJECT2 with its own
 * request parser, counters and hit counter.  Rules (task brief section 1, rule set R3):
 *
 *   1. Canonical numbers only.  A number is a plain decimal integer: no sign, no leading zero, no blank,
 *      no trailing text, value >= 1.  Anything else is INVALID.
 *   2. Same-kind comparison.  The parsed event of target 2 is compared with the parsed event of target 1
 *      of the SAME kind only:
 *        s4malloc            : compare the S4_malloc stream index   (S4FMM_NTH vs S4FMM_NTH2)
 *        plancall            : compare the pair (K, M)              (plancall:K:M vs plancall:K':M')
 *        linearsolve_null2   : compare the pair (ID, K)             (linearsolve_null2:ID:K vs ...)
 *      If the pair is equal, target 2 is INVALID: it never fires and stderr receives one line
 *        S4FMM INJECT2 INVALID <reason>
 *   3. Cross-kind requests are never a conflict.  Each kind counts its own event stream
 *      (S4_malloc calls from FMM objects, fft_plan_dft_2d calls, per-site LinearSolve calls).  Where the
 *      streams are identical, the same physical event can be indexed by both targets; the event
 *      streams and their sources are listed in DUAL_EVENT_STREAMS_R8_M2a2.tsv.
 *   4. Runtime fallback (defence only, not a rejection).  If target 1 consumed an event in the same
 *      hook call that target 2 would have fired on, target 2 is skipped and the process prints
 *        S4FMM INJECT2 SUPPRESSED <reason>
 *      and counts it in n_suppressed2.  Pre-registered configurations must not trigger this.
 *   5. Target 2 has its own counters (n_hits2), its own hit lines ("dual target2 ..."), and read-only
 *      query functions s4fmm_inject2_hits(), s4fmm_inject2_requested(), s4fmm_inject2_invalid(),
 *      s4fmm_inject2_suppressed().
 *
 * Environment:
 *   S4FMM_INJECT2 = s4malloc                  with S4FMM_NTH2 = canonical integer >= 1
 *   S4FMM_INJECT2 = plancall:K:M              K-th fft_plan_dft_2d call of the process, M-th wrapped malloc inside it
 *   S4FMM_INJECT2 = linearsolve_null2:ID:K    ID in {134,138,144,244,375,265,273}, K-th call of that ID (>= 1)
 *
 * This file contains no getenv of TMPDIR and no absolute path.  It does not read any file.
 */
#include "fmm/fft_iface.h"
#include <complex>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>

/* ---- target 1 state (names and logic copied from R2 for the parts that the target 2 rules compare against) ---- */
static const char *t1_mode(void){ const char *m = getenv("S4FMM_INJECT"); return m ? m : ""; }
static const char *t1_nth_text(void){ const char *e = getenv("S4FMM_NTH"); return e ? e : ""; }

/* hit counters (shared by both targets; n_hits counts every applied injection) */
static long n_hits = 0;
static long n_hits2 = 0;

/* ---- canonical integer parsing (rule 1) ---- */
/* Returns 1 and sets *out when s is a canonical decimal integer >= 1: first character 1..9, all others 0..9,
 * no sign, no blank, no leading zero, nothing after the digits, at most 9 digits (fits in int on every target). */
static int canon_pos(const char *s, long *out){
	if(NULL == s || s[0] < '1' || s[0] > '9'){ return 0; }
	long v = 0;
	int len = 0;
	for(const char *p = s; *p != '\0'; ++p){
		if(*p < '0' || *p > '9'){ return 0; }
		v = v * 10 + (long)(*p - '0');
		if(++len > 9){ return 0; }
	}
	if(v < 1){ return 0; }
	*out = v;
	return 1;
}

/* ---- target 2 request state ---- */
static int t2_parsed = 0;
static int t2_kind = 0;            /* 0 none, 1 s4malloc, 2 plancall, 3 linearsolve_null2, -1 invalid */
static long t2_nth = 0;            /* kind 1: S4_malloc stream index */
static long t2_k = 0, t2_m = 0;    /* kind 2: plan call K and malloc M; kind 3: call K (t2_m unused) */
static int t2_id = 0;              /* kind 3 */
static long n_invalid2 = 0;        /* requests refused by rule 2 (0 or 1 per process) */
static long n_suppressed2 = 0;     /* target 2 skipped because target 1 consumed the same event (rule 4) */
static long t2_malloc_seen = 0;    /* S4_malloc stream index counter for target 2 (FMM callers only) */
static int t2_arm = 0;
static long t2_plan_alloc = 0;
static const int t2_b2_ids[7] = {134, 138, 144, 244, 375, 265, 273};

/* target 1 parsed requests used for the same-kind comparison (rule 2) */
static int t1_kind = 0;            /* 0 none/other, 1 s4malloc, 2 plancall, 3 linearsolve_null2 */
static long t1_nth_v = 0;          /* kind 1: S4FMM_NTH value (canonical) or 0 if not canonical */
static long t1_k = 0, t1_m = 0;    /* kind 2: plancall K and M (canonical) */
static int t1_id = 0;              /* kind 3 */
static long t1_k3 = 0;             /* kind 3: K (canonical) */

static void t1_classify(void){
	const char *m = t1_mode();
	t1_kind = 0;
	if(0 == strcmp(m, "s4malloc")){
		if(canon_pos(t1_nth_text(), &t1_nth_v)){ t1_kind = 1; }
		return;
	}
	if(0 == strncmp(m, "plancall:", 9)){
		/* K:M, canonical; anything else makes target 1's kind 'other' (target 1 itself refuses it, see R2) */
		const char *p = m + 9;
		const char *colon = strchr(p, ':');
		if(NULL == colon){ return; }
		char kbuf[16] = {0}, mbuf[16] = {0};
		size_t kl = (size_t)(colon - p);
		if(kl == 0 || kl >= sizeof(kbuf)){ return; }
		memcpy(kbuf, p, kl);
		strncpy(mbuf, colon + 1, sizeof(mbuf) - 1);
		if(canon_pos(kbuf, &t1_k) && canon_pos(mbuf, &t1_m)){ t1_kind = 2; }
		return;
	}
	if(0 == strncmp(m, "linearsolve_null2:", 18)){
		const char *p = m + 18;
		const char *colon = strchr(p, ':');
		if(NULL == colon){ return; }
		char ibuf[16] = {0}, kbuf[16] = {0};
		size_t il = (size_t)(colon - p);
		if(il == 0 || il >= sizeof(ibuf)){ return; }
		memcpy(ibuf, p, il);
		strncpy(kbuf, colon + 1, sizeof(kbuf) - 1);
		long idv = 0;
		if(canon_pos(ibuf, &idv) && canon_pos(kbuf, &t1_k3)){ t1_id = (int)idv; t1_kind = 3; }
		return;
	}
}

static void t2_invalid(const char *why){
	if(t2_kind != -1){ n_invalid2++; }
	t2_kind = -1;
	std::fprintf(stderr, "S4FMM INJECT2 INVALID %s\n", why);
}

static void t2_parse(void){
	if(t2_parsed){ return; }
	t2_parsed = 1;
	const char *m = getenv("S4FMM_INJECT2");
	if(NULL == m || '\0' == m[0]){ return; }
	t1_classify();

	if(0 == strcmp(m, "s4malloc")){
		long v = 0;
		if(!canon_pos(getenv("S4FMM_NTH2"), &v)){ t2_invalid("s4malloc needs S4FMM_NTH2 as a canonical integer >= 1"); return; }
		if(1 == t1_kind && t1_nth_v == v){ t2_invalid("same S4_malloc event as target 1 (same kind: same stream index)"); return; }
		t2_kind = 1; t2_nth = v;
		return;
	}
	if(0 == strncmp(m, "plancall:", 9)){
		const char *p = m + 9;
		const char *colon = strchr(p, ':');
		if(NULL == colon){ t2_invalid("plancall needs K:M as canonical integers >= 1"); return; }
		char kbuf[16] = {0}, mbuf[16] = {0};
		size_t kl = (size_t)(colon - p);
		if(kl == 0 || kl >= sizeof(kbuf)){ t2_invalid("plancall needs K:M as canonical integers >= 1"); return; }
		memcpy(kbuf, p, kl);
		strncpy(mbuf, colon + 1, sizeof(mbuf) - 1);
		long k = 0, mm = 0;
		if(!canon_pos(kbuf, &k) || !canon_pos(mbuf, &mm)){ t2_invalid("plancall needs K:M as canonical integers >= 1"); return; }
		if(2 == t1_kind && t1_k == k && t1_m == mm){ t2_invalid("same plan event as target 1 (same kind: same (K, M))"); return; }
		t2_kind = 2; t2_k = k; t2_m = mm;
		return;
	}
	if(0 == strncmp(m, "linearsolve_null2:", 18)){
		const char *p = m + 18;
		const char *colon = strchr(p, ':');
		if(NULL == colon){ t2_invalid("linearsolve_null2 needs ID:K as canonical integers"); return; }
		char ibuf[16] = {0}, kbuf[16] = {0};
		size_t il = (size_t)(colon - p);
		if(il == 0 || il >= sizeof(ibuf)){ t2_invalid("linearsolve_null2 needs ID:K as canonical integers"); return; }
		memcpy(ibuf, p, il);
		strncpy(kbuf, colon + 1, sizeof(kbuf) - 1);
		long idv = 0, k = 0;
		if(!canon_pos(ibuf, &idv) || !canon_pos(kbuf, &k)){ t2_invalid("linearsolve_null2 needs ID:K as canonical integers"); return; }
		int known = 0;
		for(int i = 0; i < 7; ++i){ if(t2_b2_ids[i] == (int)idv){ known = 1; } }
		if(!known){ t2_invalid("linearsolve_null2 ID is not one of the seven B2 sites"); return; }
		if(3 == t1_kind && t1_id == (int)idv && t1_k3 == k){ t2_invalid("same LinearSolve event as target 1 (same kind: same (ID, K))"); return; }
		t2_kind = 3; t2_id = (int)idv; t2_k = k;
		return;
	}
	t2_invalid("unknown target 2 kind");
}

/* ---- read-only query functions for the driver (rule 5) ---- */
extern "C" long s4fmm_inject2_hits(void){ t2_parse(); return n_hits2; }
extern "C" int s4fmm_inject2_requested(void){ return '\0' != (getenv("S4FMM_INJECT2") ? getenv("S4FMM_INJECT2")[0] : '\0'); }
extern "C" long s4fmm_inject2_invalid(void){ t2_parse(); return n_invalid2; }
extern "C" long s4fmm_inject2_suppressed(void){ return n_suppressed2; }

/* ---- rule 4 helper: target 1 consumed this event?  The caller passes the hit counter before target 1 ran. ---- */
static void t2_note_suppressed(const char *where, long hits_before){
	if(n_hits != hits_before){
		n_suppressed2++;
		std::fprintf(stderr, "S4FMM INJECT2 SUPPRESSED %s (target 1 consumed the event; target 2 skipped)\n", where);
		return;
	}
}

/* ---- S4_malloc wrapper: target 2 stream (FMM callers only; the symbol is wrapped by --wrap=_Z9S4_mallocm) ---- */
extern "C" void *__real__Z9S4_mallocm(size_t);
extern "C" void *__wrap__Z9S4_mallocm(size_t size){
	t2_parse();
	const long idx = (1 == t2_kind) ? ++t2_malloc_seen : 0;
	/* target 1 (unchanged from R2) */
	const long hits_before = n_hits;
	if(0 == strcmp(t1_mode(), "s4malloc")){
		static long n_s4malloc = 0;
		n_s4malloc++;
		if(canon_pos(t1_nth_text(), &t1_nth_v) && n_s4malloc == t1_nth_v){
			n_hits++;
			std::fprintf(stderr, "S4FMM HIT real S4_malloc failure: FMM call %zu B (hit=%ld)\n", size, n_s4malloc);
			return NULL;
		}
	}
	/* target 2 */
	if(1 == t2_kind && idx == t2_nth){
		if(n_hits != hits_before){
			t2_note_suppressed("s4malloc", hits_before);
		}else{
			n_hits2++;
			n_hits++;
			std::fprintf(stderr, "S4FMM HIT dual target2 real S4_malloc failure: FMM call %zu B (stream index %ld, hit2=%ld total=%ld)\n", size, idx, n_hits2, n_hits);
			return NULL;
		}
	}
	return __real__Z9S4_mallocm(size);
}

/* ---- fft_plan_dft_2d wrapper: target 2 arms its own plan call K (rule 2 compares (K, M) with target 1) ---- */
extern "C" void *__real__Z15fft_plan_dft_2dPiPSt7complexIdES2_i(int*, std::complex<double>*, std::complex<double>*, int);
extern "C" void *__wrap__Z15fft_plan_dft_2dPiPSt7complexIdES2_i(int *n, std::complex<double>*a, std::complex<double>*b, int s);
